stemMd: Which feature defines an artery, irrespective of its oxygen content?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It always contains valves along its length.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It carries blood towards the heart.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It carries blood only to the lungs.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It carries blood away from the heart.

explanationMd: Vessels are classified by direction relative to the heart. Oxygen content varies between systemic and pulmonary circuits, so oxygenation is not the definition.

distractorRationale.b: This defines the direction of veins.
distractorRationale.d: The pulmonary artery is a counterexample.
distractorRationale.c: Systemic arteries supply the rest of the body.
distractorRationale.a: This is not the defining property of arteries.
